testCase.name: [local] S04 Every dictation surface in both contexts gives the same fidelity

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S04 Every dictation surface in both contexts gives the same fidelity

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 4)
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value. (UAT 3.4)
  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (TFA-94423 AC 1; TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09))

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given One Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, empty text fields; for Fix by voice, panels seeded with known values (fixture helpers or a typed Save Note first); the add-patient form open on the Hospital list

When Speak H-01 and H-03 into each Hospital free-text surface and N-01 and N-03 into each Nursing Home one, one take each; speak the VF, AP and ET items into Fix by voice, the add-patient form and encounter-task dictation

Then Every free-text surface shows the same exact numbers, drug names and °C as the pre-round box in S01/S02; no surface rewrites the text; Fix by voice and the add-patient form store exactly the dictated values and leave every field that was not mentioned unchanged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Item checks from S01/S02 (numbers, boundaries, occurrences) on every free-text surface; a surface that fails where the pre-round box passes is a surface bug, quoted with both texts. Fix by voice and add-patient write structured fields through a model: every mentioned field equals the dictated value exactly (temperature with no °F and no converted value), and no field that was …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Partly judged: fixing vitals, labs and meds by voice keeps the dictated values, but whether every dictation box hears the words the same way is blocked on the OpenAI key approval.

Evidence: allure-results/0ff9467b…: the model half passes 6/6 (voicefix VF-1…5, AP-1 on Haiku). The fidelity half is blocked by the key, and several surfaces are not driven yet (encounter notes, bedside recording, Quick Dictation, Ask AI, encounter tasks, NH Important Points).

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-23/S01; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S04

Every dictation surface in both contexts gives the same fidelity

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-dictation: status blocked in aicheck-dictation/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (aicheck-dictation/plan.json, automatable: partly): (1) free-text surfaces with the S01 harness: Hospital pre-round, Hospital Important Points, NH Pre-Round, NH Encounter (built); fidelity per surface needs the live engine. (2) model half without OpenAI: the dictated words as a perfect transcript through ai/voicefix arrangeVitals/arrangeLabs/arrangeMedications (with the Medications panel's currentList) and extractPatientDetails, merged the way VitalsPanel/MedicationsPanel merge; checks = S04 expectFields (dictated values exact, temperature never °F, unmentioned fields unchanged). ET-1 goes verbatim into the task box (no model), so it is a free-text surface. — Fidelity half gated on the key; model half (VF-1…VF-5, AP-1) ran and decided 6/6 through the real ai/voicefix actions, merged by a COPY of VitalsPanel/MedicationsPanel's merge as on main e02167f (voicefix-check.ts; would not follow the panels if they change). Not driven through the UI yet: the Dictate buttons of Fix by voice / add-patient, Hospital encounter notes, bedside recording, Quick Dictation, Ask AI box, encounter tasks and NH Important Points surfaces.

Detail:

Model half decided (no OpenAI; dictated words given as a perfect transcript to the action the app calls): 6/6 pass (VF-1, VF-2, VF-3, VF-4, VF-5, AP-1; Haiku on Bedrock). The merge into the panel is a copy of VitalsPanel/MedicationsPanel's merge as on main e02167f (scripts/aicheck-dictation/voicefix-check.ts), not the panels themselves; it would not follow the panels if they change. laneB-preconditions not met: the local OPENAI_API_KEY ends …PUMA and there is no OK on record from Quinn that it is not the key dev uses (her 2026-10-09 notes say it may be), so no audio was sent to OpenAI. Run after that OK: QA_DICT_MODE=live QA_DICTATION_LIVE_OK=PUMA scripts/aicheck-dictation/run.sh. harness self-test with the scripted far end: 8/8 takes landed in the box and passed the checks (shim, Dictate/Stop, read rule, engine attribution, checks.ts). The scripted self-test behind this entry ran before the review fix and used the real prepareSession: each take minted one OpenAI client secret (client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on api.openai.com) with the local key …PUMA — no audio, but the gated key was used. Free-text surfaces driven: Hospital pre-round, Hospital Important Points, NH Pre-Round, NH Encounter. Not driven yet: Hospital encounter notes, 'Start bedside recording', Quick Dictation, Ask AI question box (both contexts), encounter tasks (ET-1, transcript goes verbatim into the task box), NH Important Points, and the Dictate buttons of Fix by voice / add-patient (their model half is decided above).

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
